author: claude
summary: Adds an undo action to the shared toast mechanism and wires it into 4 non-queue delete flows (task 009). emitToast(message, action?) now dispatches { message, action } on the studio-toast CustomEvent; useToast/App.tsx already rendered toast.action, so App.tsx's listener now forwards detail.action through to showToast. Each of the 4 call sites has no backend undo-delete endpoint, so all defer the actual destructive request (fetch/api call) behind a setTimeout keyed to TOAST_VISIBLE_MS (4000ms, exported from utils/toast.ts) -- clicking the toast's Undo button just clearTimeouts the pending request; letting it expire lets the real delete run. QueueItem.tsx/GlobalQueue.tsx intentionally untouched (task 011).

files.change: Added exported ToastAction interface ({label, onClick}) and TOAST_VISIBLE_MS=4000 constant (single source of truth, reused by useToast.ts and the 4 delete-flow call sites). emitToast(message, action?: ToastAction) now includes action in the dispatched CustomEvent detail.

ToastState.action and showToast's action param now use the shared ToastAction type imported from utils/toast.ts instead of an inline duplicate; TOAST_VISIBLE_MS also now imported from there rather than locally defined.

The studio-toast window-event listener now destructures detail.action (typed via ToastAction) and forwards it to showToast(message, action) -- previously the action was silently dropped even though useToast/the toast JSX already supported it.

handleDelete(name) no longer calls DELETE /api/speaker-profiles/{name} immediately; it schedules the request via setTimeout(TOAST_VISIBLE_MS) tracked in a pendingDeletesRef keyed by name, and emits a 'Deleted voice "name".' toast with an Undo action that clearTimeouts the pending request.

handleDeleteChapter(chapterId) defers api.deleteChapter + onDataRefresh behind the same setTimeout/pendingChapterDeletesRef pattern; emits 'Chapter deleted.' with Undo. Returns true immediately (callers never used the previous resolved boolean).
confirmDelete() closes the delete modal immediately but defers api.deleteProject + loadProjects behind setTimeout/pendingProjectDeleteRef; emits 'Project deleted.' with Undo.

handleDelete's ConfirmModal onConfirm now defers api.deleteCharacter + the setCharacters filter (row removal) behind setTimeout/pendingDeletesRef keyed by character id; emits 'Deleted "name".' with Undo. The failure toast ('Failed to delete character.') still fires from the deferred callback if the delete rejects.
New: emitToast dispatches {message, action} on the studio-toast event; action is optional/undefined by default.
New: showToast carries an action through to toast state, action.onClick is invocable, dismissToast clears both.
handleDelete test rewritten to assert the DELETE fetch is deferred (not called until TOAST_VISIBLE_MS elapses) and the toast carries an Undo action; new test for Undo cancelling the pending delete.
handleDeleteChapter test rewritten for the deferred-delete + Undo-toast shape; new test for Undo cancelling the pending delete.

confirmDelete test rewritten for the deferred-delete + Undo-toast shape (scoped vi.useFakeTimers/useRealTimers around just this test to avoid affecting the file's other waitFor-based tests); new test for Undo cancelling the pending delete.

Replaced the single delete-failure test (which asserted on immediate api.deleteCharacter rejection) with three tests reflecting the deferred design: undo toast fires immediately without removing the row or calling the API; Undo cancels the pending delete; letting the timer elapse commits the delete and surfaces the failure toast on rejection. Mock of '@/utils/toast' extended to export TOAST_VISIBLE_MS.
